summary: Iteration 6 permissions/restrictions tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering admin view-only, manager same/cross department, member own-row-only, GET returns all rows for all roles, approve-deliverable stage progression, and admin deliverable edit without stage fields. Frontend: Admin toolbar hides Add/Bulk/Close-Deliverable/draft-row and every cell in every row is disabled (including checkbox and Deliverable Link renders as plain span). Manager-1 (Content) sees a solid green 'Deliverable Closed' button as the FIRST child of the toolbar; Content-created rows are editable while Design/Animation rows are disabled. Close Deliverable modal opens with Project + Deliverable selects and Close Stage button. Member-1 never sees the Close Deliverable button; can only edit own row (even other Content-dept rows are disabled). Admin Edit Deliverable modal shows Current Stage & Stage Status as read-only badges (data-testid deliverable-modal-stage-readonly and -stage-status-readonly present, editable versions absent).

issues: A11y console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent (radix dialog). Non-blocking but should be addressed by adding <DialogDescription>.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to CloseDeliverableModal to silence radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py scoped_update_fields: manager check uses 'user.department and creator_department and user.department != creator_department' — if creator_department is None (e.g. system/admin-created rows or missing user), manager is allowed to edit. Consider explicitly blocking when creator_department is None.
bulk_update_work_items silently skips items the caller can't edit (no per-item error surfaced) — UX-wise the frontend won't know which failed; acceptable for now but worth reporting.
CloseDeliverableModal uses approveDeliverable directly, which is admin/manager only — good. But member won't see the button, so no issue.
test_credentials: No auth — X-User-Id header / 'Acting As' role switcher. Users listed in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed work items across users (manager-1, manager-2, member-1, member-2, member-3) and TEST_ projects for approve-deliverable flow. All cleaned up via bulk-delete and project DELETE at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 permission model is stable. If touching worksheet permissions again, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_permissions_iter6.py (set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var before pytest). Frontend rowCount selector `worksheet-row-` also matches nested `worksheet-row-checkbox-` — use `[data-testid^='worksheet-row-']:not([data-testid*='checkbox'])` if precise count needed.
